title: Lemma local-sarkozy: symmetric arithmetic progression in kA − kA
statement_scope: Let G be an abelian group, S⊂G finite with |S+S| ≤ K|S| or |S−S| ≤ K|S|, and k∈N. If A⊂S satisfies |A| ≥ δ|S| where δ > K^{3k/2}/|S|^{1/(k+1)}, then kA − kA contains a symmetric arithmetic progression of length at least 2^{k+1} passing through 0, with non-zero step d ∈ A−A. The author's definition permits degenerate progressions in some groups.
